anchor: My sorcerer just reached character level fifteen; how many eighth-tier magic slots and how many prepared options do I now have?
At what character level does my chosen magic-user finally unlock an eighth-tier slot and a total of eighteen prepared options?
Is there a headpiece that lets me launch a fiery beam at +5 to hit, but only once until the next sunrise?
What uncommon worn item for my head can fire a ranged blast of flame, then needs a new day before it works again?
Which fiend can shroud an area in magical gloom whenever it wants, and once a day stun a foe outright while also confusing them?
Which demon can cancel magical effects at will, and once a day can fly, confuse foes, or stun them with a single word?
What druid-style trick makes plants erupt from the ground in a 20-foot square, turning it to rough terrain and holding failed resisters in place?
What nature magic lasting up to a minute at 90 feet lets held creatures break free with a brawn check after failing a resistance roll?
Which heated stand lets me call a flame creature to obey my orders for an hour, appearing as near to the stand as possible?
I want a stationary fire-based item that conjures a servant of flame which acts right after me in initiative and vanishes after an hour.
I'm looking for a nature-devoted order whose members meet among trees or standing stones and speak in a secret language.
Which nature caster path has wise elders acting as priests for their communities, safeguarding ancient rites and lore?
Which disguise magic lets me reshape several people's looks for eight hours, though a personality-based roll lets unwilling ones resist?
What eight-hour appearance-altering trick falls apart under touch, so a sharp-eyed observer can spot the disguise by a careful inspection check?
Which hooded garment lets me vanish from sight for an hour by pulling up its cowl, with a few uses recharging at dawn?
Which legendary garment needs attunement and makes me unseen for up to an hour, ending if I take it off or lower its cowl?
Which horde of tiny vermin can squeeze through any gap a Tiny creature fits, resist physical weapon damage, and can't be knocked prone?
What pest cluster can share a creature's space and scale walls at thirty feet per turn, and it can't regain hit points once wounded?
What small wooden box floats and can be commanded to become a rowing craft or a larger sailing vessel, with three different command words?
Which rare box weighing only four pounds can open for storage and transform into a ship that shrinks back when no one is aboard?
Which crystal eyewear lets me spend charges to enchant a humanoid into friendliness, with stronger versions for more charges?
What uncommon crystal lenses hold three uses that refill at dawn, letting me sway a creature's mind with a difficulty-13 enchantment?
When I make one strike with a melee weapon on my turn, can I also swap weapons during that same action, before or after the swing?
If I get several swings per turn from a class feature, can I walk between them during that action without losing them?
Which colossal beast takes three extra turns after others act, letting it run and claw or tail foes, or send a quake knocking medium-sized creatures prone?
Which giant creature's ground-shaking ability breaks concentration and knocks medium foes flat, and can't be reused until its next turn?
What sixth-tier trick creates a staged image that performs when a condition I set off happens, then goes dormant for ten minutes?
Which hidden visual decoy stays unseen until a sight or sound nearby happens, then acts out a script for up to five minutes?
Which bard-style ability lets me reroll an ally's failed roll against being enchanted or scared, with a quick reaction, and the retry rolls with advantage?
What singer's talent wards my companions within thirty feet against mind-controlling and fear effects, letting them retry a failed roll?
Which eighth-level smoky blaze fills a 20-foot sphere with embers that drifts ten feet each turn, dealing 10d8 burn damage on a failed agility roll?
What smoky ember sphere can I steer each turn, blinding everyone inside and burning anyone who fails a nimbleness check when it arrives?
What healing effect restores hit points to up to six people within a 30-foot radius of a point I can see, rolling five eight-sided dice plus my modifier?
Which fifth-tier restorative energy wave heals half a dozen allies at once, gaining an extra eight-sided die for each higher slot used?
Which lycanthrope changes between a human-sized rodent hybrid, a tiny rodent, or normal form, keeping the same numbers except size, while gear stays put?
What cursed shapechanger keeps identical combat stats whether it's a tiny rodent or a humanoid hybrid, but its clothes and tools don't transform?
Which eight-limbed sea creature can grab a medium-sized creature with all its limbs and release a blinding dark cloud once a day when hurt underwater?
What large underwater beast can hold its breath for an hour out of the water and react to being hurt by spreading an obscuring fog?
What enchantment lets me mark an item so I can later call it to my hand from any distance by crushing a costly blue gem?
Which high-tier magic lets me yank a small object of up to ten pounds to me across any distance, and if someone holds it, tell me their location?
Which frigid air blast hits everything in a 60-foot triangular spread, and creatures slain by it stay frozen solid until they thaw?
What 5th-tier freezing blast deals 8d8 damage on a failed toughness roll, or half on a success, rising by 1d8 with higher slots?
What ninth-tier magic opens a circular doorway to another plane that lasts up to a minute and can drag a named creature through?
I want a high-level rift to other worlds that lasts a minute and can pull a creature I name from far away, though it keeps its free will.
What first-tier magic creates a hidden, mindless helper that does chores like cooking and mending for an hour, vanishing if struck to zero?
What helper-making trick lets me give a mental nudge each turn so the hidden force moves 15 feet and tidies up, staying within 60 feet of me?
Which reanimated corpse can freeze a non-elf in place with its claws unless it passes a hardiness roll?
Which ghastly dead creature's bite adds life-draining harm, and it is immune to toxins and being enchanted?
Which paladin ability lets me empower my held blade with holy energy for ten minutes, adding my charisma to hits and lighting a 20-foot glow?
When I'm empowered by a divine boost on a melee item, what happens to my hits, and does it stop if I let go?
What heavy melee implement can be smashed into the ground to split open a crack thirty feet deep and knock people flat?
Which magical heavy-hitting item causes seismic tremors that break concentration and collapse structures, recharging at dawn?
Which frost-furred canine monster can knock a creature down with a bite and breathe icy wind that recharges on a roll of five or six?
What snow-dwelling beast gains advantage against a victim when a friend stands within 5 feet, and resists frost entirely?
Which set of fortune-telling tiles can strip all my portable wealth, or raise an ability score by two, depending on what I pull?
Which random fortune item can make every enchanted gear I wear disintegrate, or give me 10 temporary hit points each dawn?
What eighth-tier enchantment takes an hour to prepare with a vinegar-and-honey mix, making one kind of creature either flee or be drawn toward a target?
Which mind-altering magic makes a whole species of creatures dread or adore an object for ten days, with a fresh roll to break free once they are far away?
What 5th-tier divine column of blazing energy drops from above onto a 10-foot-wide pillar area, dealing fire and holy damage on a failed agility roll?
Which cleric-only pillar of brilliant energy falls from the heavens with two damage types and ten dice total, halved on a successful agility roll?
Which hooded lamp exposes creatures hidden from sight within its glow, burning six hours on one pint of oil?
Which uncommon lamp casts bright light in a 30-foot radius plus dimmer glow beyond, and its hood can shrink the glow to a tiny 5-foot pool?
What worn garment grants a +1 bonus to armor rating and saving rolls while I wear it, and requires attunement?
Which uncommon wrap bonds with its wearer and adds one to defense and resistance rolls while being worn?
Which upgraded berserker maneuver makes a foe roll a resistance at a handicap and blocks its escape strikes until my next turn?
After I land a hit, which late rage technique gives allies a +5 boost against that foe until my next turn?
What 25-gold-piece kit lets me judge a gemstone's value with a difficulty-15 check and craft magical focuses or holy emblems?
Which two-pound set of intelligence-based crafting gear lets me appraise jewels and make arcane focuses?
As a performer-scholar at level six, which perk lets me add two borrowed options from other casting lists that are always ready?
Which level-six perk allows swapping one of its borrowed options each time I level up, as long as it's a cantrip or fits my slots?
Which level-17 martial artist technique plants a delayed vibration in a foe after a fist hit, dealing 10d12 force when ended on a failed toughness roll?
Which monk ability lets me spend four focus to set a delayed lethal pulse inside one creature for a number of days equal to my level?
At first level, what occult pact feature lets me pick a forbidden-lore power of my choice and swap it out each time I gain a level?
Which pact-caster feature involves forbidden lore powers with minimum level requirements, and can't be swapped if another power depends on it?
What very rare book of guidance on persuasion raises my social trait by two after 48 hours of study over six days or fewer?
Which rare reading material boosts a person's social trait once, then goes dormant for a century before regaining its magic?
Which bard-style ability lets me use a quick reaction to lower a visible foe's damage or check by my song die when they're within 60 feet?
I want a verbal trick that unsettles foes so they miscalculate, drawing on a song die resource I already have.
Which evil fiend with a bag of stolen souls has advantage on rolls against enchantments and casts a few divinations when two kin are close by?
What wicked crone-like monster has 112 hit points and a dream-haunting bag that crumbles when destroyed, releasing trapped souls?
